# Motion fixtures

Original MIT-licensed procedural clips for descriptors, representative poses,
timing variants, compression, skinning, and Library Preview transitions.
`Layered-preview.glb` and `Multi-clip-wave.glb` exercise source/target changes
across clips and skin palettes. `Twist-rigid.glb` and `Twist-affine.glb` distinguish
rigid dual quaternion skinning from the affine matrix fallback.
